exceptions.source: tests/testkit/snapshot_lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::rejection detects same-content replacement of an existing file
exceptions.reason: The rejection observer requires /bin/sh, /bin/mv and POSIX device/inode identity. Missing observers fail prerequisites; Windows is excluded before semantic execution.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/snapshot_lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::snapshot timestamps separate completed baseline reads from final observations
exceptions.reason: The hardlink timestamp observer requires /bin/ln, /usr/bin/touch, /usr/bin/true and observable file access-time updates after a synchronized content read. Missing observers or unobservable timestamp updates fail prerequisites; Windows is excluded before semantic execution.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/network_lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::network fixture startup deadline reaps the actual direct child
exceptions.reason: The direct-child reaping observer uses POSIX process and signal facilities. Missing observers fail prerequisites; Windows is excluded before semantic execution.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/environment_wbtest.mbt::spawn boundary records controlled environment instead of host defaults
exceptions.reason: The environment observer launches fixed /usr/bin/true. Missing observer prerequisites fail; Windows is excluded before semantic execution.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::HTTPS fixture rejects untrusted TLS and releases its subprocess port
exceptions.reason: The native lifecycle test requires the OpenSSL s_server observer. Windows CI does not provision or validate this fixture; the registered package adapter must skip it before reporting evidence.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::missing metadata observer never produces a partial snapshot
exceptions.reason: POSIX stat observer failure is exercised only on POSIX hosts.

exceptions.source: tests/testkit/lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::snapshot failure after success retains streams and infrastructure classification
tests/testkit/lifecycle_wbtest.mbt::deadline returns only after the direct child is reaped
exceptions.reason: The process observer requires /bin/sh and /bin/kill; grandchildren remain outside this assertion.
Permission fault injection requires a non-root POSIX user and /bin/chmod plus /usr/bin/id.

exceptions.source: commands/ls/main_wbtest.mbt::command-line dereferencing differs from traversal and reports broken links
exceptions.reason: The test returns before assertions on Windows because symlink traversal fixtures require POSIX support.
The observer launches /usr/bin/true and the test returns before assertions on Windows.
The observer requires /bin/sh and the test returns before assertions on Windows. A missing POSIX shell is not a passing lifecycle observation.
